about_the_game:
Russian Village Business is a simulator of a young entrepreneur in the Russian countryside.

You open your first small shop in a remote village and try to establish trade in everything the locals might need — from bread and milk to soda and toilet paper.

It all starts with a simple rural store, but over time you can grow your business, expand your inventory, and earn the respect of the locals. However, life in the countryside isn’t just about work! You’ll find plenty of activities and events around the map: take care of your property, help neighbors, go fishing, or just take a day off.

The game’s world lives on its own — villagers visit your store, chat about news, ask for credit, and even haggle over prices.

You decide your path: become an honest merchant, a cunning dealer, or just a “good guy” everyone in the village knows and trusts.

Russian Village Business combines elements of a shop simulator, everyday life, and sandbox gameplay — all in the cozy, humorous, and familiar atmosphere of the Russian countryside.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-2500k (4 core 3.3 GHz) or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4 core 3.1 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 6 GB or AMD Radeon™ RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel™ Core i7-3770 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8GB VRAM with Shader Model 5.0 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: It’s a simulator of a young entrepreneur in a Russian village, where the player must open their own store in the countryside, establish trade in essential goods, and at the same time improve both their own prosperity and the quality of life of the local residents.
